Question: A cylinder can be viewed as the solid formed by:

Choices.A:
Rotating a right triangle through one full revolution about one of its legs

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h106_q1_choiceA_en.svg)
Choices.B:
Rotating a semicircle through one full revolution about its diameter

[Figure 2](figures/cnm_h106_q1_choiceB_en.svg)
Choices.D:
Rotating a rectangle through one full revolution about one of its sides

[Figure 4](figures/cnm_h106_q1_choiceD_en.svg)

Solution: Rotating a rectangle about one side produces a cylinder. Rotating a right triangle produces a cone, and rotating a semicircle produces a sphere.
